factual_methodology.summary: Verified primary FAO October 2 2026 950 Mt/31.7%/216.9 Mt cereal measures; IEA October 14 observed oil stocks -509 Mb and September -10 Mb; DOE October 16 SPR site inventories 282.2 Mb; GIE October 28 849.11 TWh/74.96%; USGS 2026 rare-earth reserves China 44 Mt/Brazil 21 Mt/Australia 6.3 Mt/US 1.9 Mt and phosphate Morocco 50 Gt; UNICEF 2025 3.223 billion vaccine deliveries and category counts; WHO ICG 6m yellow-fever doses; WFP 2025 580 shipments/8040 t; SOFI 2026 645m hunger/2.1bn insecurity; Svalbard >1.4m samples. Reserves, flows, installed capacity and inventories are not summed.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: 40 numbered analytical chapters in each locale; institutional, neutral treatment of allocation, access, processing and compound-risk scenarios; quantified observations dated and separate from forecast, inference and scenarios. References numbered inline with full bibliographic details at end; no public QA labels.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Six data-linked quantitative charts per locale, two regional maps, three causal flows and one mindmap; matching values and units across languages. Phosphate rest-of-world 23 Gt is explicitly labeled 73-50 residual, not independent observation. Charts show source data and regional maps disclaim exact stockpile locations.

research_depth.summary: Forty substantive sections per locale with quantitative panel, control-and-substitution atlas, five falsifiable compound shock scenarios, sector-specific missing data inventory, investment trade-offs and 24 end references.

evidence_traceability.summary: Twenty-four numbered source URLs in both locales; primary institutional spot-checks for FAO, IEA, USGS, DOE, GIE, WHO, UNICEF, WFP and Svalbard. Distinct observation dates and units preserved; unavailable global private pharmaceutical, fertilizer and industrial spares stocks explicitly left unknown.

bilingual_parity.summary: Identical 40-section outline, 24 reference destinations, 12 deterministic visual fences per locale and numerically identical six chart series; no material mismatch in reviewed quantitative panel.

counterfactual_review.summary: Five scenarios distinguish assumptions from observed evidence, include observable tests; competing scarcity and technological-adaptation interpretations and falsifiers appear in chapter 39.

source_freshness.summary: Observation and publication dates individually disclosed; no invented October 29 closing market observations. October 2026 FAO/IEA/GIE/DOE, 2026 USGS/WHO/FAO and 2025 UNICEF/WFP vintages appropriately labeled.

contrary_evidence: Large global cereal stocks do not establish that every importing country can obtain food or maintain household affordability.
USGS mineral reserves measure geological endowment, not deliverable metals or qualified industrial components.
2025 UNICEF vaccine deliveries are annual flows and cannot be treated as stock held in October 2026.
IEA energy inventory movements, GIE gas readings and FAO crop forecasts use different statistical coverage and observation dates.
A global estimate is not stated for essential pharmaceuticals, transformer spares and private fertilizer inventories because comparable verified data are lacking.
limitations: This is a multi-vintage analytical inventory, not a synchronized physical stock census.
USGS mineral reserve estimates can be revised and are not deliverable inventories.
Global proprietary medicine, fertilizer and specialized industrial-spares stocks lack comparable verified datasets.
GIE storage readings and DOE site snapshots are date-specific; ongoing market conditions may change.
The all-pending editorial-depth CI fails on five pre-existing rejected drafts, with no failure reported for this candidate.
notes: Independent QA performed on staged blobs at reviewed HEAD. CI validate-pipeline.mjs passed with 155 public bundles; all-pending depth CI failures concern unrelated previously rejected drafts. Approval does not assert live deployment.
